headline: Palestinian aid worker who organized World Cup screenings killed in Israeli strike
context: Palestinians are mourning Mohammed al-Wahidi, a beloved aid worker in Gaza. He was killed by as Israeli airstrike while en route to a World Cup screening which he organized.
